column1: # Luwian word list for ASJP-40 (doculect LUWIAN, config/added_languages.tsv). ASJP has no Luwian list.
# Licence: forms and analyses from eDiAna (Hutter, Hackstein, Zinko et al.), https://www.ediana.gwi.uni-muenchen.de/,
# CC BY-SA 4.0. This file is an adaptation and is likewise under CC BY-SA 4.0 (the rest of config/ is not).
# Composite, as in IE-CoR: Cuneiform Luwian (CLuw) where eDiAna has a syllabically attested lemma with secure meaning,
# Hieroglyphic Luwian (HLuw) only to fill the gaps. 23 concepts. Left out (see config/luwian_review.tsv): logogram-only
# (two, ear, knee), unattested (*new, *tongue in HLuw), meaning debated (liver ikkuwar-, tongue lāli-, nose, sun),
# no lemma (one, fish, louse, tree, leaf, skin, tooth, night, star).
# ASJPcode: x for ḫ (ASJP's convention, also in its Palaic list; its Hittite list uses h), s for š, c for z (/ts/),
# geminates kept as written, length unmarked.
